_about: MediAid remedies knowledge base. Common minor problems only. Medicine doses are standard adult over-the-counter doses; always follow the pack label. Have a doctor or pharmacist review before real use.

paracetamol.name: Paracetamol 500 mg tablet
paracetamol.adult_dose: 1 tablet every 6 hours if needed. Do not take more than 4 tablets in 24 hours.

ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen 200 mg tablet
ibuprofen.use: pain such as headache or muscle pain
ibuprofen.adult_dose: 1-2 tablets every 6-8 hours after food if needed. Do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours.

cetirizine.name: Cetirizine 10 mg tablet
cetirizine.adult_dose: 1 tablet once a day, preferably at night. It can make you sleepy, so do not drive after taking it.

saline_drops.name: Saline nasal drops or spray
saline_drops.adult_dose: 2-3 drops in each nostril 3-4 times a day.

antacid.name: Antacid gel (aluminium hydroxide + magnesium hydroxide)
antacid.adult_dose: 10-20 ml after meals and at bedtime. Take it 2 hours apart from other medicines.
interacts_with: other medicines taken at the same time

ors.name: ORS (oral rehydration salts)
ors.use: replacing water and salts lost in loose motions
ors.adult_dose: Mix 1 sachet in 1 litre of clean drinking water. Sip often, especially after each loose motion. Use within 24 hours.

isabgol.name: Isabgol (psyllium husk)
isabgol.adult_dose: 1-2 teaspoons in a full glass of water once or twice a day. Drink extra water through the day. Take it 2 hours apart from other medicines.
interacts_with: other medicines taken at the same time

lozenges.name: Throat lozenges
lozenges.adult_dose: Suck 1 lozenge every 2-3 hours as needed, as written on the pack.

povidone_iodine.name: Povidone-iodine antiseptic ointment or solution
povidone_iodine.adult_dose: Apply a thin layer on the clean wound 1-2 times a day.

diclofenac_gel.name: Diclofenac pain-relief gel
diclofenac_gel.adult_dose: Rub a thin layer on the painful area 3-4 times a day. Do not use on broken skin. Wash hands after use.

calamine.name: Calamine lotion
calamine.adult_dose: Dab on the itchy area 2-3 times a day.

entries.name: Common cold
entries.description: Runny or blocked nose, sneezing, mild sore throat and mild body ache, usually without high fever.
home_care: Rest and drink plenty of warm fluids like water, soup and herbal tea.
Take steam inhalation 2-3 times a day to open a blocked nose.
Gargle with warm salt water if the throat is scratchy.
Wash hands often and cover your mouth when sneezing.
see_doctor_if: Fever above 39 °C or fever lasting more than 3 days
Breathing difficulty or chest pain
Symptoms lasting more than 10 days
Ear pain or thick yellow-green discharge with face pain

entries.name: Mild fever (viral fever)
entries.description: Raised temperature with body ache, tiredness and chills, without danger signs.
home_care: Rest and drink plenty of fluids: water, ORS, coconut water, soup.
Wear light clothes and sponge the body with lukewarm (not cold) water.
Check your temperature 2-3 times a day and note it down.
Eat light, easy food like khichdi or dal-rice.
see_doctor_if: Fever above 39.4 °C, or fever for more than 3 days
Rash, red spots, bleeding gums or severe body pain
Severe headache, stiff neck, confusion or fits
Vomiting so you cannot keep fluids down, or very little urine
Breathing difficulty

entries.name: Tension headache
entries.description: Dull, pressing headache around the forehead or both sides, often after stress, screen time, poor sleep or skipped meals.
home_care: Rest in a quiet, dim room and drink a glass or two of water.
Take a break from screens every 30-40 minutes.
Eat on time and sleep 7-8 hours.
Gently massage your neck, shoulders and temples.
see_doctor_if: A sudden, very severe headache (the worst of your life)
Headache with fever and stiff neck, or with vomiting
Weakness, numbness, vision changes or trouble speaking
Headache after a head injury
Headaches that keep coming back or get worse over weeks

entries.name: Acidity and heartburn
entries.description: Burning in the upper stomach or chest after food, sour burps, gas and indigestion.
home_care: Eat small meals and avoid very spicy, oily or fried food.
Do not lie down for 2-3 hours after eating; have dinner early.
Cut down on tea, coffee, alcohol and smoking.
Drink a glass of water or cold milk when it burns.
see_doctor_if: Chest pain spreading to the arm, jaw or back, or with sweating
Vomiting blood or black stools
Trouble swallowing or losing weight without trying
Acidity on most days for more than 2 weeks

entries.name: Loose motions (mild diarrhoea)
entries.description: Watery or loose stools a few times a day, often after outside food, without blood or high fever.
home_care: Drink ORS, water, buttermilk, coconut water or rice water after every loose motion.
Eat light food: khichdi, curd rice, banana, toast.
Avoid oily, spicy and outside food, and milk if it makes it worse.
Wash hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.
see_doctor_if: Blood or mucus in the stool
Loose motions for more than 2 days, or more than 6-8 times a day
Signs of dehydration: very little urine, dizziness, dry mouth, sunken eyes
High fever or severe stomach pain
A baby, young child or elderly person with loose motions

entries.name: Constipation
entries.description: Hard stools, passing stool less often, or straining.
home_care: Drink 8-10 glasses of water a day.
Eat more fibre: fruits like papaya and guava, vegetables, whole grains, dal.
Walk or exercise for 20-30 minutes every day.
Go to the toilet at the same time each day and do not hold it in.
see_doctor_if: Blood in the stool or black stools
Severe stomach pain, swelling or vomiting
No stool for more than 4-5 days
Constipation that lasts more than 2 weeks or is new after age 50

entries.name: Sore throat
entries.description: Scratchy or painful throat, pain while swallowing, often with a cold.
home_care: Gargle with warm salt water (half a teaspoon of salt in a glass) 3-4 times a day.
Drink warm water; honey with warm water helps (not for children under 1 year).
Rest your voice and avoid very cold drinks and smoking.
Steam inhalation can soothe the throat.
see_doctor_if: Trouble breathing or swallowing saliva
High fever or white patches on the tonsils
Sore throat lasting more than a week
Swelling in the neck or a muffled voice

entries.name: Allergic sneezing (allergic rhinitis)
entries.description: Repeated sneezing, itchy nose, watery eyes and runny nose, often triggered by dust, pollen or weather change.
home_care: Stay away from what triggers it: dust, smoke, pollen, strong smells.
Wear a mask when sweeping or travelling on dusty roads.
Rinse your nose with saline and wash your face after coming home.
Keep bedsheets and pillow covers clean; wash them weekly in hot water.
see_doctor_if: Wheezing, chest tightness or breathing difficulty
Swelling of lips, face or throat
Symptoms that disturb sleep or work most days
Thick coloured discharge with face pain or fever

entries.name: Minor cut or scrape
entries.description: A small, shallow cut, scrape or graze where bleeding stops with pressure.
home_care: Wash the wound gently with clean running water.
Press with a clean cloth for 5-10 minutes to stop bleeding.
Cover with a clean bandage and change it daily or when wet.
Check that your tetanus vaccine is up to date (every 10 years, or 5 years for dirty wounds).
see_doctor_if: Bleeding that does not stop after 10 minutes of pressure
A deep or gaping cut, or a cut on the face
Dirt or glass stuck in the wound, or a rusty object / animal bite
Redness, swelling, pus or fever after 1-2 days

entries.name: Muscle pain or mild sprain
entries.description: Aching or stiff muscles after exercise, lifting or a small twist, without major swelling or deformity.
home_care: Rest the area and avoid the movement that hurts for 1-2 days.
Put a cold pack (ice wrapped in cloth) for 15 minutes, 3-4 times a day for the first 2 days.
After 2 days, use a warm compress and do gentle stretches.
For a sprained ankle or wrist, keep it raised on a pillow.
see_doctor_if: You cannot move the joint or put weight on it
A lot of swelling, bruising or the limb looks bent
Numbness, tingling or weakness
Back pain with leg weakness, or trouble controlling urine
Pain not better after 1 week

entries.name: Insect bite
entries.description: Small, itchy, red bumps from mosquito, ant or other insect bites.
home_care: Wash the area with soap and water.
Put a cold compress on it for 10 minutes to reduce swelling and itching.
Do not scratch; keep nails short.
Use a mosquito net or repellent to prevent more bites.
see_doctor_if: Swelling of lips, face or throat, or trouble breathing
Rash all over the body or dizziness
The bite becomes very red, hot, painful or has pus
Fever after mosquito bites (could be dengue or malaria)

entries.name: Mouth ulcer
entries.description: One or a few small painful sores inside the mouth, on the tongue or gums.
home_care: Rinse your mouth with warm salt water 2-3 times a day.
Avoid spicy, sour and very hot food until it heals.
Use a soft toothbrush.
Eat foods rich in B vitamins: milk, curd, eggs, green leafy vegetables.
see_doctor_if: An ulcer that lasts more than 2 weeks
Many ulcers at once, or ulcers that keep coming back
A painless patch or ulcer, especially if you use tobacco
High fever or trouble eating and drinking
